title: Run Papyrus without an AWS login: signed-in CLI for operations, narrow server APIs behind it
description: Ryan, 2026-11-02: Papyrus operations must not need an AWS CLI login, which is less secure. The goal is better privacy and security through minimization. Rule: an operator signs in as a user with papyrus login, and the site API, which holds narrow server-side permissions and checks staff groups, does the work. Reads come first, then narrow writes. Deploys and infrastructure stay in the pipelines. Whatever cannot move is listed as break-glass, with a reason.
